optional_host_hardening.benefit: reduces the chance that an authorized writer can bypass the normal candidate/validation workflow
optional_host_hardening.activation_rule: configure when the user requests non-bypassable enforcement or repository risk/criticality justifies the stronger assurance
optional_host_hardening.baseline_effect: absence does not block Agent operation or UAOS release

deferred_work.reason: Common orchestration is a method vocabulary, not a mandate to reshape every domain product.

known_limitations: same-model self-critique, refinement or debate is candidate-generation evidence and is not independent semantic verification by itself
hosted CI provides independent execution evidence, not independent semantic architecture judgment
raw connector remains outside Python ActionCoordinator, so the baseline does not claim physical non-bypassability
GitHub rulesets/protected branches are optional defense-in-depth, not a baseline completion condition
A-share 0.2.0 architecture is production-verified, but real current-session Tonghuashun/Level-2 access must still be proven at runtime before Level-2-specific evidence claims
readiness_semantics: UAOS 2.5.2 is a patch-level ownership cleanup over production common contract 1.6.0. Financial 0.8.4, Video 0.6.0 and A-share 0.2.0 are domain-specialized children: each owns its own business identity/state/product rules and inherits common cognition/evolution/product-governance method without becoming a copy of the parent or another domain. The A-share child is production-verified; remaining candidate work is only retiring the parent-owned ashare:recommendation state in favor of one ashare:main domain router.
